definition: AI-assisted software development is the use of artificial intelligence (AI) to augment software development.
details: It uses large language models (LLMs), AI agents, and other AI technologies to assist software developers. It helps in a range of tasks of the software development life cycle, from code generation to debugging, editing, testing, UI design, understanding the code, and documentation. Agentic coding denotes the use of AI agents for software development.
story: Think of a referee whose job is to be completely honest about who touched the ball last.
